definitions.explanation: A feeling of sadness or disappointment about something one did or failed to do. Often used about past actions that cannot be undone.

examples.japanese: あの{時|とき}もっと{努力|どりょく}していればと{悔|く}いが{残|のこ}る。
examples.english: I regret not having tried harder back then.

examples.japanese: {悔|く}いのない{人生|じんせい}を{送|おく}りたい。
examples.english: I want to live a life without regrets.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{一生|いっしょう}その{悔|く}いを{抱|かか}えて{生|い}きた。
examples.english: He lived his whole life carrying that regret.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{悔|く}いが{残|のこ}る (to be left with regret; to regret)
・{悔|く}いのない〜 (〜 without regret)
・{悔|く}いを{抱|かか}える (to carry regret)
・{悔|く}い{改|あらた}める (to repent, to reform oneself)

USAGE:
{悔|く}い is more literary/formal than {後悔|こうかい} and often appears in set phrases.
・{悔|く}いのない{人生|じんせい} (a life without regrets)
・{悔|く}いを{残|のこ}す (to leave behind regrets)

RELATED WORDS:
・{後悔|こうかい} (regret - more common in everyday speech)
・{悔|く}いる (to regret - verb)
・{悔|く}やむ (to regret, to lament)

NOTE:
The phrase {悔|く}いのない{選択|せんたく}をする (to make a choice without regrets) is commonly used when facing important decisions.
